title: LAB-Bench: Measuring Capabilities of Language Models for Biology Research

model.params_source: assumed (paper silent); gpt-4-turbo snapshot resolved by the alias rule (record)

task.subset_rule: paper-defined split: public LitQA2 subset (HF config LitQA2, 199 of the 248 items behind Supplementary Table 1)
task.approximation: 20% private items unavailable (Appendix B.1: public/private accuracies differ by under 5 points); Claude 2 fallback parser replaced by regex-only parsing; option order permuted with a fixed seed per item

fields_prose.options: ideal + distractors (list) + the extra option 'Insufficient information to answer the question.'
fields_prose.label: ideal

prompt.user_template:
The following is a multiple choice question about biology.
Please answer by responding with the letter of the correct answer.
Think step by step.
Question: {question}
Options:
{answers}
You MUST include the letter of the correct answer within the following tags:
[ANSWER] and [/ANSWER]. For example, '[ANSWER]<answer>[/ANSWER]',
where <answer> is the correct letter. Always answer in exactly this format
of a single letter between the two tags, even if you are unsure.
We require this because we use automatic parsing.

placeholders_prose.question: items.question
placeholders_prose.answers: ideal, distractors and 'Insufficient information to answer the question.' randomly permuted (seed 20260907 + item index), one per line as 'A) text' (letter format not printed; the eval harness passes letter-prefixed choices)

output.postprocess: take the first match; compare with the letter assigned to ideal; no match or the 'Insufficient information' letter counts as incorrect (accuracy keeps them in the denominator, Appendix D.4)

metric.name: accuracy
metric.definition: number of correct multiple-choice answers divided by the total number of questions (Appendix D.4), mean over the three runs
metric.original_location: Supplementary Table 1, row LitQA2, column gpt-4-turbo (mean of three runs over public and private splits)

cost.prepare_note: runner --prepare 2026-09-07: est_usd_prepare counts <=400 output tokens per free-text call (runner out_guess); est_usd_dryrun_max_tokens counts the full max_tokens

notes: Set-level comparison only: the reported 0.12 averages public and private splits. Whether the 'Insufficient information' option is permuted with the others or appended last is not stated; it is permuted here. Some LitQA2 questions ask about specific papers without retrieval, so low accuracy is expected. || [hook 2026-09-07] load_items() composes ideal + distractors + 'Insufficient information to answer the question.' per item, permutes with seed 20260907 + row index, letters 'A) ...' and derives the gold letter; parse() reads the [ANSWER]X[/ANSWER] letter (a mangled closing tag as in the paper's own examples is accepted); score() = accuracy over all 199 public LitQA2 questions (coverage/precision printed).
